description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling restart sentinel data, including reading, writing, consuming, and formatting restart sentinel information in a Node.js environment.

classes.name: RestartSentinelLog
classes.description: Type representing logs associated with restart sentinel steps.

classes.name: RestartSentinelStep
classes.description: Type representing individual steps in the restart process.

classes.name: RestartSentinelStats
classes.description: Type representing statistics and metadata about the restart process.

classes.name: RestartSentinelPayload
classes.description: Type representing the payload data for a restart sentinel event.

classes.name: RestartSentinel
classes.description: Type representing the overall restart sentinel object containing version and payload.

methods.name: formatDoctorNonInteractiveHint
methods.description: Generates a non-interactive hint string for running the openclaw doctor command.

methods.name: resolveRestartSentinelPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the restart sentinel JSON file based on environment.

methods.name: writeRestartSentinel
methods.description: Writes a restart sentinel payload to a JSON file at the resolved path.

methods.name: readRestartSentinel
methods.description: Reads and parses the restart sentinel JSON file, returning null if invalid or not found.

methods.name: consumeRestartSentinel
methods.description: Reads and deletes the restart sentinel JSON file, returning its content or null.

methods.name: formatRestartSentinelMessage
methods.description: Formats a user-friendly message string from a restart sentinel payload.

methods.name: summarizeRestartSentinel
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a restart sentinel payload.

methods.name: trimLogTail
methods.description: Trims a log tail string to a maximum character length, adding ellipsis if truncated.
